pairs.subject: terminal-multiplexing
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/lib/tauri.ts:12 The client foundation's only native boundary is a typed Tauri invoke/listen wrapper for wallet commands and events, with no pseudo-terminal, emulator, or session multiplexer. I searched for xterm, node-pty, portable_pty, scrollback and tmux across apps/desktop/client (excluding node_modules/dist) and found nothing, and the client package.json lists no terminal emulator dependency, so the subject's precondition (a host presenting many interactive terminal sessions) does not hold here.
